title: Speculative abstraction
signal: imagined variation
false_positive_guard: real boundary or proven variation
smallest_action: inline, delete, or defer

title: Pass-through layer
signal: meaningless forwarding
false_positive_guard: compatibility, logging, retry, transaction, or translation owner
smallest_action: remove the layer or give it ownership

title: Responsibility drift
signal: unrelated decisions share an owner
false_positive_guard: temporary sequencing only
smallest_action: move one decision to its natural owner

title: State owner blur
signal: state or invariant has multiple mutation owners
false_positive_guard: explicit aggregate or transaction owner
smallest_action: name the owner and route mutation there

title: Internals leakage
signal: callers depend on internal shape
false_positive_guard: owned extension or stable DTO
smallest_action: expose an owned API

title: Adapter owns policy
signal: adapter decides domain policy
false_positive_guard: adapter-only normalization or translation
smallest_action: move policy home

title: Dependency cycle
signal: dependency points both ways
false_positive_guard: runtime callback without compile-time cycle
smallest_action: move policy, invert adapter, or split contract

title: Policy-to-adapter dependency
signal: policy imports framework, storage, or vendor detail
false_positive_guard: policy-owned plugin or port contract
smallest_action: add an owned contract or move adapter outward

title: Shared-core gravity
signal: shared core absorbs volatile policy
false_positive_guard: stable utility
smallest_action: move policy home

title: Hidden mutable state
signal: globals, singletons, or caches couple flows
false_positive_guard: immutable config or explicit scoped lifetime
smallest_action: pass state through owner or scope lifetime

title: Vocabulary split
signal: conflicting term or synonym
false_positive_guard: bounded context plus translator
smallest_action: rename, qualify, or translate

title: Duplicate concept drift
signal: same concept diverges across models
false_positive_guard: intentional boundary copy with translator
smallest_action: converge inside the boundary or translate

title: External model collapse
signal: external shape becomes internal state
false_positive_guard: stable CRUD meaning
smallest_action: add edge translation

title: Shotgun change
signal: one rule requires scattered edits
false_positive_guard: migration with exit
smallest_action: add the rule owner

title: Migration without exit
signal: compatibility shim has no removal path
false_positive_guard: short migration with owner, trigger, and deadline
smallest_action: add exit condition or collapse completed path

title: Flag pile-up
signal: flags lack owner, expiry, or return path
false_positive_guard: short rollout with owner and trigger
smallest_action: add removal or collapse completed path

title: Unstated quality tradeoff
signal: quality claim or NFR lacks proof or a response measure
false_positive_guard: no quality claim, or an NFR that already has a measured scenario
smallest_action: state force, tradeoff, and validation, or write a quality-attribute scenario with a response measure, then delegate

title: Unmeasured quality tactic
signal: quality tactic lacks owner or measurement
false_positive_guard: measured tactic with owner and rollback
smallest_action: add metric, owner, and rollback or remove tactic

title: Unallocated NFR
signal: quality requirement has no owning boundary
false_positive_guard: owning boundary named, or requirement out of current scope
smallest_action: assign the NFR to an owning boundary or split it across owners
default_severity: info/warn; block an NFR that gates the change but has no owner

title: Ownership mismatch
signal: boundary crosses owner
false_positive_guard: shared owner or small project
smallest_action: align owner or state contract
default_severity: warn when known; info when uncertain

title: Deprecation without lifecycle
signal: deprecated element lacks a replacement, owner, or removal trigger
false_positive_guard: staged deprecation with owner, replacement, and removal trigger
smallest_action: add replacement, owner, and removal trigger, or remove
default_severity: warn; block permanent deprecation with live consumers and no plan

title: Stale-dependency or big-bang-upgrade debt
signal: dependency far behind its supported line with no cadence or owner, or a big-bang upgrade where incremental is feasible
false_positive_guard: measured currency with an upgrade cadence and owner
smallest_action: add cadence and owner, or decompose into incremental upgrades
default_severity: info/warn; delegate security risk to devsecops-audit

title: Version or implementation divergence
signal: multiple concurrent versions/forks of one shared concern with no convergence owner, or unbounded internal producer/consumer skew
false_positive_guard: single supported version, or bounded skew with a named convergence owner and exit
smallest_action: name a convergence owner and plan, and bound the skew
default_severity: warn; block unbounded divergence of a shared concern

title: Unowned concurrency
signal: spawned or background work lacks a lifetime, join, or cancellation owner, or cancellation does not propagate across the boundary
false_positive_guard: supervised or scoped work with a named owner, or bounded run-to-completion work
smallest_action: give the work an owning scope that joins or cancels it, and propagate caller cancellation
default_severity: warn; block detached work with no owner or cancellation path

title: Error-contract collapse
signal: one failure shape hides domain, transport, and infrastructure meanings or retryability, or failures are swallowed mid-path
false_positive_guard: documented edge translation with mapped failure classes, or a top-level reporter at the entrypoint
smallest_action: split the taxonomy or translate explicitly, and name retryable versus terminal classes
default_severity: warn; block swallowed failures on state-changing paths

title: Stacked failure handling
signal: retries, timeouts, or fallbacks repeat across layers of one call chain with no owning layer or budget
false_positive_guard: one documented owning layer with an explicit budget and idempotence evidence
smallest_action: pick one owning layer, give it an explicit budget, and remove the rest
default_severity: warn; block stacked retries on non-idempotent operations
